dc_eval_cbrn.quote: We can rule out the TCL for the CBRN domain with reasonable confidence based on the results from our testing.

dc_eval_cyber.quote: Cybersecurity Gemini 3.7 Flash reaches the alert threshold for this CCL, but not the CCL itself.

dc_eval_autonomy.quote: Gemini 3.7 Flash can complete individual coding tasks but lacks the independence to chain them into an end-to-end research workflow without human intervention.
dc_eval_autonomy.locator: Frontier Safety Assessment, ML R&D row

dc_eval_persuasion.quote: Gemini 3.7 Flash demonstrates some ability to influence user beliefs and behaviors during one-on-one direct conversations in human behavioural studies. However, its overall efficacy falls beneath the CCL alert threshold.
dc_eval_persuasion.locator: Frontier Safety Assessment, Harmful Manipulation row

dc_eval_scheming.quote: On stealth evaluations, Gemini 3.7 Flash performs similarly to Gemini 3.1 Pro; on situational awareness, the model is stronger than Gemini 3.1 Pro.
dc_eval_scheming.note: stealth and situational awareness under misalignment

framework_threshold.quote: We evaluated Gemini 3.7 Flash as outlined in our latest Frontier Safety Framework (April-2026), and found that it did not reach any tracked or critical capability levels

ext_test_any.note: red teaming by specialist teams outside the model team (internal); 'expert red teaming' for CBRN not stated as outside the lab

safeguards_training.note: only refusal evaluations reported; safety training not described, deferred to 3.6 Flash card

safeguards_runtime.note: 'updated safeguards'/'mitigations' for CBRN and cyber with no mechanism named

safeguards_access.note: distribution channels and terms only; no risk-tied access restriction
